data.gender_notes: Karlan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word ‘karal’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘man’. The name Karlan has a strong, regal connotation and is often associated with leadership, courage, and determination. The name Karlan carries the meaning “Man, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karlan usually hope their child will grow to embody man, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

For instance, during the Middle Ages, scholars and nobles adopted Germanic names, including Karlan, to signify their rank or status. Additionally, in modern times, fictional works like Karlans from Star Wars or Lord Karlan from the Princes of the Power series have perpetuated the idea of "Karlan" as a powerful leader or protector.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual meaning behind the name Karlan can be interpreted in various ways, depending on one's beliefs. Some may consider the name as a reminder of God's strength and sovereignty in their lives, using it as a reflection of their faith and trust in the Lord. Others may view the name as a call to action, evoking thoughts of taking on leadership roles and (heroically) serving and protecting others in their communities. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Karlan is deeply personal and subjective, shaped by each individual's unique sense of faith and purpose.
